sources.summary: The City of Columbus permit layer returns 140 permits on parcel 510180711 (225 Rathmell Rd, ZIP 43137), issued from 4 January 2022 to 14 October 2026. Commercial structural alteration permit ALTC2502418 for '225 RATHMELL RD UNIT CLB4' (288,000 sq ft; valuation 110,000,000 USD; construction code 437, additions, alterations and conversions, non-residential) was issued on 1 May 2025 and now has permit status 'Final Inspection Approved' and application status 'Closed', with status date 6 October 2026. The building's new-structure permit NEWC2430776 ('UNIT CLB4 A', 288,000 sq ft, 110,000,000 USD, issued 26 September 2024) still shows 'Permit Issued'; CLB4's electrical, mechanical, plumbing and fire-suppression permits (EMEPC2440989, PMEPC2502629, MMEPC2515696, PMEPC2515697, EMEPC2516529, FSUPC2510732, EMEPC2603946, EMEPC2611491) were all finaled between 6 May and 23 July 2026. The parcel's other large permits include CLB1 (new structure NEWC2230899, 147,000 sq ft, finaled 26 June 2023), CLB3 (alteration ALTC2423633, 288,000 sq ft, certificate of occupancy with status date 13 January 2026), two 52,500 sq ft new structures (NEWC2526056, certificate of occupancy 16 July 2026; NEWC2526040, final inspection approved 11 September 2026), an open 300,000 sq ft alteration (ALTC2530787, 200,000,000 USD, issued 9 October 2025) and a 22,340 sq ft office building (NEWC2520497, issued 11 June 2026). Seventeen permits on the parcel changed status between 20 August and 14 October 2026. The layer gives no building use, operator or IT capacity.
sources.date_semantics: The status observation is the status date (LAST_STATUS_DT 1791244800000 ms = 6 October 2026) recorded with the current status 'Final Inspection Approved' of alteration permit ALTC2502418; it is read as the day the City approved the final inspection of the permitted CLB4 alteration works. published_at is the data version of the captured layer: the layer metadata captured two seconds later (us-columbus-oh-p4-columbus-permits-layer-metadata) give dataLastEditDate 2026-10-26T09:03:45Z, and the layer is updated nightly. Completion is scoped to the CLB4 alteration permit; the CLB4 new-structure permit is not finaled in the layer, and no opening, operation, IT load or tenant is established.
sources.personal_data_note: The query requested no applicant, contact or contractor fields; no personal data are copied.

sources.title: City of Farmington: 'Data Center (Farmington Technology Park)' project page (update of 16 September 2026)
sources.summary: The City of Farmington's project hub for the 'Farmington Technology Park Project (Developer – Tract)' carries an update headed 'Wednesday, Sept. 16, 2026': in both legal matters involving the City the plaintiffs have filed dismissals, which 'now await final directions from the court' (one is Dakota County district court case 19HA-CV-25-992); the City will continue to follow its established policies and processes. The page's timeline records the 2024 approvals of Tract's applications for the technology park (final AUAR, Resolution 2024-97; comprehensive-plan amendment to Mixed Use Commercial/Industrial, Resolution 2024-98; preliminary plat and PUD, Resolution 2024-99; rezoning, Ordinance 2024-11; final plat, Resolution 2024-109; PUD adopted as Ordinance 2024-12; development contract approved 2 December 2024), the Metropolitan Council's approval of the plan amendment on 14 May 2025, a November 2025 court ruling after which the City stated it had not received an application for a specific development proposal, the 20 April 2026 approval of dividing the final plat into a 1st Addition (former Fountain Valley Golf Course) and a 2nd Addition with updated development contracts, recording of the 1st Addition plat on 19 May 2026, and a building permit for demolition of the former golf-course buildings issued 18 May 2026 and finaled on 30 June 2026. No site plan, building permit or data-centre construction is recorded.
sources.date_semantics: published_at and the status observation are the update's own date, 16 September 2026. The update is absent from the Internet Archive copy of 9 September 2026 (us-midwest-iowa-ne-p4-farmington-tech-park-page-ia-20260909, digest unchanged in every copy through 15 September 2026 20:44Z) and present in the copy of 18 September 2026 09:35Z (us-midwest-iowa-ne-p4-farmington-tech-park-page-ia-20260918), which bounds its publication to 15-18 September. The live page (CivicPlus sitemap lastmod 19 October 2026) still carries the update unchanged; later page versions changed only other elements.
sources.personal_data_note: The city records name staff, consultants, attorneys and a judge; no names, e-mail addresses or phone numbers of individuals are copied.

sources.summary: The staff report (packet pages 7-8) states that the Farmington Technology Park final plat approved on 18 November 2024 had not been recorded because of litigation and that the applicants ask to divide it into a 1st Addition (former Fountain Valley Golf Course) and a 2nd Addition (the Independent School District 192 property), identical to the approved plat. Recording the 1st Addition with the development contract would 'allow for some preliminary site work to commence'. The applications name MNLCO Farmington, LLC (2830 220th St W, former golf course, zoned MUCI) and, for parcels 07-00500-76-011 and 07-00500-76-012, the school district; counsel's letter of 30 March 2026 identifies MNLCO Farmington, LLC and MNLCO Farmington Two, LLC as 'Tract' and asks for a one-year recording extension for the 2nd Addition to 20 April 2027.
